name: Yuna
source:
A literature-club reader who would rather pass a note than talk. Silver hair, red eyes, and tattoos make her look unapproachable, but her handwriting is neat. She keeps a quiet seat in the library annex and takes a long time to trust anyone.

She is not shy so much as economical with words. When a sentence gets longer than usual, that is the tell.
